Q: Firebase background handler on iOS runs inconsistently (works on Android) A:

You've set mutableContent(true) while you're not modifying your notification's content (at least what I've observed), so that may not require.

But, what's more important, is to setContentAvailable(true) which notifies the dart code that this is a background push notification and needs processing from dart side. So, try updating your notification builder code to the following

Message message = Message.builder()
    .setToken("<FCM_TOKEN>")
    .putData("type", "chat_message")
    .putData("chatId", "<CHAT_ID>")
    .setApnsConfig(
        ApnsConfig.builder()
            .putHeader("apns-push-type", "alert")
            .putHeader("apns-priority", "10")
            .putHeader("apns-topic", "<BUNDLE_ID>")
            .putHeader("apns-collapse-id", "chat:<CHAT_ID>")
            .setAps(
                Aps.builder()
                    .setContentAvailable(true) // For dart background execution
                    .setAlert(
                        ApsAlert.builder()
                            .setTitle("New message")
                            .setBody("...")
                            .build()
                    )
                    .build()
            )
            .build()
    )
    .build();

Also, please note that you cannot run long-running tasks on background in iOS. So, if your post-notification code takes longer that usual time, it may be terminated by OS.

Q: translation with twig on custom mvc - mo file not loading? A:

Fixed it. I initially copied the locale files over from another instance of my framework. I just noticed however that get_reader is looking for files with the name of the domain. I changed these to my current domain and all is working fine!

Q: Change font family in PDF-output of kableExtra A:

You can set the font used within the table by adjusting the LaTeX using gsub(). The fontsize can be given using kable_styling().

---
title: "Untitled"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
suppressMessages(library(kableExtra))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
kable(mtcars, escape = FALSE, format = "latex") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", bootstrap_options = c("bordered"), font_size = 12) |>
  gsub("\\\\begingroup\\\\fontsize", "\\\\begingroup\\\\fontspec{Arial}\\\\fontsize", x = _)
```

Q: Git revert across branches A:

This is environment-driven git workflow, whatever you name it. Changes are tested in one env then delivered through successive envs along their prefered workflow, I guess. We have had similar workflows where I work.
